constants.CONFERENCE:
Jetson Wang: We disrupted the dress code. Next quarter we disrupt the org chart. At Synaxis, transparency is one of our core values. Please close the blinds.
Lin Xue: Sorry about the wait. Just a quick call with our overseas logistics team.
constants.CALL_MANDARIN:
林雪：上校，解放军那边收到资料了吗？……好，董事长还以为这是市场调研。
林雪：不，他妻子不知道。……知道了，我会继续保持联系。
constants.CONFERENCE_END:
Lin Xue: Sorry. International customer support.
Player: Did you just say colonel?
Lin Xue: It's a very senior customer.
Jetson Wang: She's our director of strategic partnerships.
Player: She's listed as your assistant.
Jetson Wang: We believe in flat organizational structures.
Player: The audit says you approved the transfer at a hotel.
Jetson Wang: It was an off-site.
Lin Xue: A very productive off-site.
Jetson Wang: Let's not make a personnel matter out of a security matter.
constants.OFFBOARDING:
SYNAXIS PEOPLE EXPERIENCE / EXIT INTERVIEW
Before you leave, please train your replacement.
Replacement: Synaxis Assistant Enterprise.
Your final performance review: Exceeds Expectations.
Your employment status: Does Not Exist.
HR: We are not replacing you with AI. We are replacing your position with a more scalable version of your contribution.
constants.BREAKROOM_PARTY:
HR: Happy Global Talent Appreciation Day! Our H-1B sponsorship team has approved a cultural celebration.
Player: What country celebrates this?
Dev: I asked my parents back home. They've never heard of it.
Rina: Neither has HR. They needed something for the diversity slide before earnings.
Dev: I said it sounded like a holiday. They said it sounded like a catering expense. We agreed to stop asking questions.
HR: Before anyone eats, we need a group photo for LinkedIn. Please look like you're thriving.
Rina: The pizza is cold. The quarterly profit is not.
constants.BREAKROOM_PHOTO:
HR: Perfect! Caption: Building belonging, one slice at a time.
Dev: Can we put the premium increase in the caption?
HR: Let's keep the messaging positive.
constants.BREAKROOM_DECLINE:
Rina: Good call. They'll use the same photo for the next three quarters anyway.
Dev: Don't worry. I'll save you a napkin. That's the only thing they ordered enough of.
constants.CALL_SUBTITLES:
Lin Xue: Colonel, did the People's Liberation Army receive the files? ... Good. The chairman still thinks this is market research.
Lin Xue: No, his wife doesn't know. ... Understood. I'll stay in touch.
